h01.

**S3 presign runner — every 12 hours (with one immediate run at startup) — `server/server.go:162-171`**

Externally-stored attachments (`AttachmentStorageType_S3`) are referenced by S3 presigned URLs, which expire (set to a 5-day expiry). The `s3presign.Runner` walks all S3-backed attachments in batches and re-presigns any URL that isn't valid for at least the next 4 days, updating the attachment's `Reference` (the link) and `LastPresignedTime`. This keeps the stored links from going stale.

- **Component:** `s3presign.Runner` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go` (loop `Run` at :29, work in `CheckAndPresign` at :47).
- **Schedule:** `runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`), driven by a `time.Ticker`. It refreshes any attachment whose presigned URL isn't good for the next 4 days (`runner.go:85-91`).
- **Wiring into startup:** `server/server.go`. `startBackgroundRunners` (called from startup at `server.go:129`) constructs the runner and does an immediate `RunOnce(ctx)` at `server/server.go:163`, then launches the recurring `Run` loop in a goroutine at `server/server.go:169`.

h02.

**Delivery function:** `Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (the actual outbound HTTP dispatch happens at `safeClient.Do(req)`, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:152`). `PostAsync` (`webhook.go:184`) just enqueues onto a bounded channel whose worker goroutines call `Post`.

**Protection mechanism:** SSRF guard at dial time via `safeDialContext` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:59`, wired into the shared `safeClient`'s `http.Transport.DialContext` (`webhook.go:32-37`). It resolves the target host and rejects any address in a reserved/private range using `isReservedIP` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:44`) against `reservedCIDRs` (loopback, RFC-1918, link-local/cloud IMDS `169.254.169.254`, and IPv6 equivalents; `internal/webhook/validate.go:14-23`). Because the check runs on the resolved IP at connect time, it also defeats DNS-rebinding. (There is additionally an up-front `ValidateURL` check at `internal/webhook/validate.go:62` when webhooks are configured, but the enforcement that protects the actual delivery is `safeDialContext`. Both can be bypassed by the opt-in `AllowPrivateIPs` flag, `validate.go:41`.)

- `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` (on every memo creation).

**Extracted properties** (from `ExtractAll` → `ExtractedData` / `MemoPayload_Property`):
- **`Tags`** — the list of distinct `#tags` in the content (`markdown.go:376-378`, `418`).
- **`Property.Title`** — text of a leading H1 heading, if present (`markdown.go:384-388`).
- **`Property.HasLink`** — content contains a link (`markdown.go:393-394`).
- **`Property.HasCode`** — content contains code (block/fenced/inline span) (`markdown.go:396-397`).
- **`Property.HasTaskList`** — content contains task-list checkboxes (`markdown.go:399-400`).
- **`Property.HasIncompleteTasks`** — at least one unchecked task (`markdown.go:401-404`).
